text.Starmarket:
How to play ==
While Starmarket is in play, if you played a base this turn (including Starmarket itself), gain either 3 Trade or 5 Authority. Starmarket is a base with a defense of 6. 
 Strategy ==
Starmarket makes a great first impression: nice art, a great name, interesting text, and the typical high Trade/Authority gain that Trade Federation cards provide so often. Although it looks very good as an early game card, remember that you only get the ability if you played a base this turn. Your opponent can also choose to bypass it and just leave it in play: if you don't have other Trade Federation cards or bases in your deck, then this card just stays in play multiple turns doing literally nothing. It becomes useful if you have at least some other Trade Federation cards (especially Security Crafts, which need allying to give Trade), or any other bases. In particular, two Starmarkets together are very strong, and bring the most expensive cards within easy reach. Even if you may not be able to use its abilities every turn, your opponent will have to spend 6 Combat to take it out and prevent you from using it the next turn. 

All in all, this card is mostly useful in the early and mid-game. Later in the game it can still be useful to provide Authority and an ally for your other Trade Federation cards.
